name: dimension-diagram
title: Dimension diagram
description: Product dimensions drawn as a simple box, cylinder or flat shape with width, height and depth labelled, switchable between cm and inches.
docs: width, height and depth are in unit (centimetres by default); a cylinder takes its diameter as width, and without a depth the drawing is a flat elevation. The drawing scales to its container and the labels keep their size; when the drawing is small or the product narrow, the width label drops just below its line so the arrows stay in sight, and a label on the object gives up its name and keeps its figure (the names are always in the text above the drawing). A switch converts between the units in units and rounds the way a shop writes it (80 cm is 31.5 in); keep the choice yourself with displayUnit and onDisplayUnitChange so one switch can drive every diagram on the page, or leave it to defaultDisplayUnit. extras adds measurements such as { label: "Seat height", value: 46 } as a dashed line across the drawing. The same numbers are written above the drawing and as one sentence for a screen reader. Always pass locale.
